request.unauthorized: A file is taken only from the app's own page or at an upload address
request.not_found: The upload address is not valid or has been used — ask for a new one
request.foreign_holder: The upload address was opened for another place

holder.unknown: It is not known where to put the file

filename.control_character: The file's name holds a control character — rename the file
filename.too_long: The file's name is too long — rename the file

file.too_large: The file is over {limit_mb} MB — the file storage's ceiling

cleanup.name: Upload request cleanup
cleanup.description: Hourly: removes the upload requests whose lifetime is over — addresses an agent asked for and never sent a file to.
